1.e4 e5 2.Bc4 Nc6 3.Nc3 Nf6 4.d3 Bc5 5.f.strategy: Brings the kingside knight into play and adds a second attacker to e5, which d6 and the c6-knight defend. It also prepares castling, but the knight now stands in front of the queen, a weakness Black can use.
Pins the knight against the queen, so any move of the knight exposes the queen, and threatens ...Bxf3 to remove an attacker of e5. Black develops with a purpose and adds pressure on the centre.
